instructions.title: Welcome to the Reading Forest!
instructions.mission: Your mission: Read the texts and answer questions to light up the magical forest.
instructions.step2: Answer questions about what you read
instructions.step6: Complete all texts to earn the badge

instructions.title: Welcome to Word Harbor!
instructions.mission: Your mission: Help repair the ship by placing each word in the correct category.
instructions.step1: Drag the blue words into the colored boxes
instructions.step2: Each word belongs to a grammatical category
instructions.step3: Correct answers repair part of the ship!
instructions.step5: Repair 6 parts to complete the ship

playing.feedbackCorrect: Well done! You placed the word in the correct category.

instructions.title: Welcome to the Number Market!
instructions.mission: Your mission: Help the shopkeeper by solving math problems to fill shopping baskets.
instructions.step1: Solve money, time and fraction problems
instructions.step2: Each correct answer fills a basket
instructions.step3: You have 3 hearts — don't lose them all!
instructions.step5: Keep all hearts for a special badge!

completed.title: Congratulations!
completed.badgeDesc: You completed all challenges without losing hearts

failed.title: Oh no!
failed.encourage: Don't worry! You can try again.

time.tip: To calculate the remaining time, count the hours and minutes from the current time until closing time. Remember that each hour has 60 minutes.

fraction.adjustHint: Use the + and - buttons to adjust your answer
fraction.tip: A fraction like ½ means «1 part of 2 equal parts». To add equal fractions: ¼ + ¼ = 2/4 = ½

feedback.timeCorrect: Correct! You calculated the remaining time correctly.
feedback.fractionCorrect: Excellent! You solved the fraction correctly.

instructions.title: Welcome to the STEAM Challenge!
instructions.subtitle: Program an explorer robot with visual blocks
instructions.mission: Program the robot to reach the goal while avoiding obstacles on a 6×6 board.
instructions.step1: Drag «move forward», «turn left» and «turn right» blocks
instructions.step2: Use «repeat» loops to optimize your code
instructions.step3: Respect the block limit for each level
instructions.step4: The robot has 3 lives per level!
instructions.goal: Complete all 6 challenges to earn +140 XP and the Junior Engineer badge.

failed.title: Out of lives!
failed.subtitle: The robot needs more attempts. Don't give up!

feedback.missedGoal: You didn't reach the goal! Try again.

blockly.maxBlocks: Use at most {{max}} blocks! You currently use {{count}}.
blockly.addBlocks: Add some blocks to program the robot!

instructions.title: Welcome to Flip Science Lab!
instructions.subtitle: Learn science by watching videos and answering quizzes
instructions.mission: Complete 4 science experiments by watching educational videos and answering questions.
instructions.step4: Earn pieces to complete your virtual experiment

playing.quizLockedDesc: Watch the full video first to unlock the quiz.

quiz.title: Quiz: {{title}}
quiz.reminder: If you don't remember an answer, you can watch the video again. You need at least 2 correct answers to earn an experiment piece.

video.loadErrorHint: Check your internet connection or try again.
video.afterVideo: When the video ends, you will answer 3 questions about the content.

feedback.pieceAdded: You added a piece to the experiment: {{name}} {{icon}}
feedback.fail: You got {{count}}/3 correct answers. You need at least 2 to continue.
feedback.retryHint: Watch the video again and retry the quiz.
feedback.answerAll: Please answer all questions before continuing.

mapamundi.title: World Map Mission v2
mapamundi.intro: Pick what to practice: continents, oceans or regions of Spain. Each correct answer adds a stamp to your passport.
mapamundi.footer: Each correct answer: +12 XP • Complete mission: +100 XP + Badge

continent.description: Locate the 7 continents of the world

playing.gameOverDesc: You ran out of lives. Try again!

passport.start: Start your adventure! Click the correct regions to earn stamps

maps.offlineTitle: The map needs an internet connection
maps.offlineHint: Check your connection and try again.
maps.oceanHint: Click the blue point on the correct ocean to select it.
maps.regionHint: Click the correct region on the map and then confirm your selection.

instructions.title: Welcome to the Time Museum!
instructions.mission: Your mission: place 8 historical events in chronological order.
instructions.step1: Read each card with its date.
instructions.step2: Drag events onto the timeline (1 = oldest).
instructions.step3: When all 8 are placed, press «Check order».

feedback.wrongOrder: Wrong order. Check the dates and try again.
